Engagement Disciplines

For your audience, your next conversation or the work ahead.

The right engagement begins with what you want people to understand, consider or do. Together, we can shape an experience around your audience, your objectives and the questions that matter.

01 / KEYNOTES & WORKSHOPS In-Person & Global Virtual

Speaking and facilitation

Keynotes, masterclasses and workshops exploring human potential, communication, storytelling, leadership, strategic visibility and human value in a changing world.

Ideal For

Annual conferences, executive leadership summits, company-wide retreats, and industry keynote stages.

Audience Takeaways

Unpacking limiting narratives, discovering distinct human value, and building actionable narrative frameworks.

Inquire for Speaking & Facilitation
02 / PANEL FACILITATION Summits & High-Level Forums

Panel moderation

Researched, thoughtfully guided discussions that connect perspectives, engage the audience and give important questions the attention they deserve.

The Approach

Rigorous pre-event speaker alignment, thematic synthesis, and active time management that ensures every voice illuminates the central inquiry.

Outcome

Dynamic, non-scripted dialogues that keep audiences intellectually engaged and deliver actionable industry takeaways.

Inquire for Panel Moderation
03 / IN-DEPTH DIALOGUES Fireside Chats & Thought Leadership

Conversation hosting

Interviews and leadership conversations that invite reflection, bring experience into focus and make room for insight beyond familiar talking points.

Distinction

Unlike standard interviews, Naomi creates an empathetic, intellectually rigorous atmosphere where leaders drop defensive posture and share genuine insight.

Deliverables

Executive retreats, broadcast and podcast dialogues, fireside chats, and keynote interview series.

Inquire for Conversation Hosting
04 / CEREMONY & STAGE LEADERSHIP Galas, Awards & High-Profile Events

Event compering

Warmth, professional presence and audience connection, with careful attention to the purpose, people and flow of your occasion.

Event Architecture

Mastery of ceremonial pacing, protocol respect, audience rapport, and seamless problem-solving under live conditions.

Atmosphere

Elevates the tone of the occasion with elegance, dignity, infectious energy, and warmth.

Inquire for Event Compering
